name: Return to MacKinley
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Here, take this pouch and give it to Sea Wolf.  And tell him I meant to pay him back!  I swear!!

I just got a little drunk and lost my way, and...you know how things are.  He'll understand - you don't have to get rough!
narrative.objectives: Bring Shaky's Payment to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Heh heh, well done! And when you showed Shaky those giblets, how hard did he shake?

Hah! He's so easy to read, when I play cards with him I can't help but win!

Thanks for your help, adventurer. Now it's your turn to get paid...
narrative.requestItemsText: Here here, adventurer. Did you get Shaky's payment?

chain.subtitle: 4 quests from level 41 to 44, 11,675 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Mistvale Giblets to "Shaky" Phillipe in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Voodoo Dues
quests.objectiveText: Bring Maury's Clubbed Foot, Jon-Jon's Golden Spyglass, and Chucky's Huge Ring to "Sea Wolf" MacKinley in Booty Bay.

quests.name: Cracking Maury's Foot
quests.objectiveText: Bring Maury's Key to "Sea Wolf" Mackinley in Booty Bay.
